```{python}
from pathlib import Path


def find_project_root(start):
    path = Path(start).resolve()
    for candidate in (path, *path.parents):
        if (candidate / ".unaltraweb" / "computations.yml").is_file():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")


width = 1240
height = 680
left_points = [
    (155, 235, "P1"),
    (270, 235, "P2"),
    (215, 335, "P3"),
    (440, 390, "P4"),
]
right_points = [(x + 680, y) for x, y, _ in left_points]

svg = [
    f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">',
    '  <title id="title">Buffers individuals i buffer dissolt</title>',
    '  <desc id="desc">A l’esquerra, quatre buffers conserven la traça dels punts P1 a P4 i se superposen. A la dreta, la unió exacta dels mateixos quatre discs, dissolta sense separar components disjunts, forma una sola entitat multipart amb dos components i sense atribució directa a cada punt d’origen.</desc>',
    '  <defs>',
    '    <style>',
    "      text { font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; }",
    "      .heading { font-size: 31px; font-weight: 700; fill: #17242c; }",
    "      .count { font-size: 25px; fill: #4c606a; }",
    "      .label { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; fill: #263943; }",
    "      .result { font-size: 25px; fill: #263943; }",
    "      .term { font-weight: 700; fill: #176b92; }",
    "      .separator { stroke: #aebcc3; stroke-width: 1.5; }",
    "      .individual { fill: #8fcde1; fill-opacity: .38; stroke: #176b92; stroke-width: 3; }",
    "      .dissolved { fill: #b2ddeb; }",
    "      .point { fill: #d85f45; stroke: #873629; stroke-width: 2.5; }",
    "      .context-point { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #687b85; stroke-width: 3; }",
    "      .operation { fill: none; stroke: #687b85; stroke-width: 3; }",
    '    </style>',
    '    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="11" markerHeight="11" refX="8" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">',
    '      <path d="M0,0 L0,7 L9,3.5 z" fill="#687b85"/>',
    '    </marker>',
    '  </defs>',
    '  <line x1="35" y1="110" x2="535" y2="110" class="separator"/>',
    '  <line x1="705" y1="110" x2="1205" y2="110" class="separator"/>',
    '  <line x1="620" y1="25" x2="620" y2="250" class="separator"/>',
    '  <line x1="620" y1="380" x2="620" y2="655" class="separator"/>',
    '  <text x="35" y="50" class="heading">Buffers individuals</text>',
    '  <text x="35" y="87" class="count">4 entitats</text>',
    '  <text x="705" y="50" class="heading">Dissoldre sense separar</text>',
    '  <text x="705" y="87" class="count">1 entitat multipart · 2 components</text>',
]

for x, y, label in left_points:
    svg.extend([
        f'  <circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="78" class="individual"/>',
        f'  <circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="8" class="point"/>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 12}" y="{y - 12}" class="label">{label}</text>',
    ])

svg.extend([
    '  <text x="620" y="297" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Dissoldre</text>',
    '  <line x1="575" y1="325" x2="665" y2="325" class="operation" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>',
])

# Opaque discs with the same fill have no visible internal seams and depict their exact union.
for x, y in right_points:
    svg.append(f'  <circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="78" class="dissolved"/>')

for x, y in right_points:
    svg.append(f'  <circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="8" class="context-point"/>')

svg.extend([
    '  <text x="895" y="451" text-anchor="middle" class="label">component 1</text>',
    '  <text x="1120" y="500" text-anchor="middle" class="label">component 2</text>',
    '  <line x1="35" y1="525" x2="535" y2="525" class="separator"/>',
    '  <line x1="705" y1="525" x2="1205" y2="525" class="separator"/>',
    '  <text x="35" y="570" class="result"><tspan class="term">Origen:</tspan> P1–P4 traçables</text>',
    '  <text x="35" y="615" class="result"><tspan class="term">Superfície:</tspan> solapament repetit</text>',
    '  <text x="705" y="570" class="result"><tspan class="term">Origen:</tspan> sense atribució directa</text>',
    '  <text x="705" y="615" class="result"><tspan class="term">Superfície:</tspan> cobertura única</text>',
    '</svg>',
])

project_root = find_project_root(Path.cwd())
output = project_root / "assets/img/generated/06-analisi-geoprocessament-vectorial/buffer-dissolve.svg"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text("\n".join(svg) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
```
